name: Campingplatz im Kaunertal
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz im Kaunertal sits at an elevation of roughly 1,400 metres in the heart of the Kaunergrat Nature Park. Close to the Kaunertal Glacier Panorama Road, it is a coveted hub for active alpine travellers. The facility offers modern sanitary blocks, electrical hookups, and dedicated pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. In summer, countless trails invite hiking and mountain biking, while the glacier ski area provides guaranteed snow in winter, complemented by an on-site inn and shop.
